description: This file defines the ConfigStructure class, which models a configuration data structure with methods for adding fields, handling memory alignment, and generating code representations such as C headers and Java fields. It appears to be part of a code generation or configuration management system.

classes.name: ConfigStructure
classes.description: Represents a configurable data structure with support for adding fields, handling alignment, and generating code in C and Java for configuration purposes.

methods.name: addAlignmentFill
methods.description: Ensures proper memory alignment by adding filler fields based on current total size.

methods.name: headerWrite
methods.description: Generates a C header struct definition representing the configuration structure.

methods.name: writeTunerStudio
methods.description: Outputs Tuner Studio-specific definitions for the configuration fields.

methods.name: writeJavaFields
methods.description: Generates Java field definitions corresponding to the configuration fields.

methods.name: addBoth
methods.description: Adds a field to both the C and TS field lists.

methods.name: addC
methods.description: Adds a field to the C fields list.

methods.name: addTs
methods.description: Adds a field to the Tuner Studio fields list.
